derived_keywords.rules_text: Adeptus Astartes units gain the Ravenwing keyword if they are drawn from the Dark Angels Chapter and are Mounted units, or Vehicle units that can Fly.

Adeptus Astartes units gain the Deathwing keyword if they are drawn from the Dark Angels Chapter and are Terminator units; Dreadnought units; Bladeguard Ancient, Bladeguard Veteran Squad, Sternguard Veteran Squad, Vanguard Veteran Squad with Jump Packs, Land Raider, Land Raider Crusader, Land Raider Redeemer, Repulsor, or Repulsor Executioner units.

unit_names_any: Vanguard Veteran Squad with Jump Packs

derived_keywords.rules_text: Outrider Squad units from your army gain the Battleline keyword while using the Company of Hunters Detachment.

detachments.name: Unforgiven Task Force

rule.name: Grim Resolve
rule.rules_text: While an Adeptus Astartes unit from your army is Battle-shocked, change the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit to 1 instead of 0. In your Command phase, select one Adeptus Astartes unit from your army; until the start of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit.

restrictions: Your army can include Dark Angels units, but it cannot include any Adeptus Astartes units drawn from any other Chapter.

enhancements.name: Shroud of Heroes
enhancements.rules_text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Once per battle, per army, when this model is destroyed, at the end of the phase, roll one D6. On a 2+, set up this model on the battlefield, unengaged and as close as possible to where it was destroyed. This model is not part of an attached unit and its unit has a Starting Strength of 1. This model has 3 wounds remaining, or its full wounds remaining if this model was Battle-shocked when it was destroyed.

enhancements.name: Stubborn Tenacity
enhancements.rules_text: Adeptus Astartes model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll if that unit is below its Starting Strength, and add 1 to the Wound roll as well if that unit is Battle-shocked and below its Starting Strength.

enhancements.name: Weapons of the First Legion
enhancements.rules_text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Add 1 to the Attacks, Strength and Damage characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons. While the bearer is Battle-shocked, add 2 to the Attacks, Strength and Damage characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons instead.

enhancements.name: Pennant of Remembrance
enhancements.rules_text: Ancient model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability. While that unit is Battle-shocked, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability instead.

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Fire Discipline
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [ASSAULT], [HEAVY] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.

stratagems.name: Unforgiven Fury
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability. In addition, if one or more Adeptus Astartes units from your army are currently Battle-shocked, until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

stratagems.name: Intractable
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just after an Adeptus Astartes unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That Adeptus Astartes unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Grim Retribution
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that had one or more models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but it must target the enemy unit that just attacked it, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.

stratagems.name: Unbreakable Lines
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

detachments.name: Lion's Blade Task Force

rule.name: In the Lion's Claws
rule.rules_text: Each time an enemy unit, excluding Monsters and Vehicles, within Engagement Range of one or more Ravenwing units from your army Falls Back, all models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from each of those tests. Each time a Deathwing unit from your army declares a charge, if one or more targets of that charge are within Engagement Range of one or more Ravenwing units from your army, add 2 to the Charge roll.

restrictions: Your army can include Dark Angels units, but it cannot include any Adeptus Astartes units drawn from any other Chapter.

enhancements.name: Calibanite Armaments
enhancements.rules_text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons.

enhancements.name: Lord of the Hunt
enhancements.rules_text: Ravenwing model only. The bearer's unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back and you can re-roll Desperate Escape tests taken for models in the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Stalwart Champion
enhancements.rules_text: Captain, Chaplain or Lieutenant model only. While the bearer's unit is not Battle-shocked, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in the bearer's unit.
restrictions: Captain, Chaplain or Lieutenant model only.

enhancements.name: Fulgus Magna
enhancements.rules_text: Deathwing model only. Once per battle, at the end of your opponent's turn, if the bearer's unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, remove the bearer's unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: Overpowering Exaction
stratagems.timing: Command phase or the start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. When doing so, if your unit has the Deathwing or Ravenwing keyword, subtract 1 from the result.
restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. If one or more Dark Angels units from your army are Battle-shocked, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1 more.

stratagems.name: Strength in Unity
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: If that enemy unit is within Engagement Range of one or more Ravenwing units from your army, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll. If that enemy unit is within Engagement Range of one or more Deathwing units from your army, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of the target, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Knights of Iron
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Ravenwing unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

stratagems.name: Illuminating Fire
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, just after a Ravenwing unit from your army has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: That Ravenwing unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within 12 inches of your unit that was selected as the target of one or more of that attacking unit's attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly Deathwing unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Inescapable Wrath
stratagems.timing: End of your opponent's Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Deathwing Infantry or Deathwing Walker unit from your army that is within 6 inches of one or more enemy units and would be eligible to declare a charge against one or more of those enemy units if it were your Charge phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit now declares a charge that only targets one or more of those enemy units, and you resolve that charge.
restrictions: A unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn if it charges using this Stratagem.

detachments.name: Wrath of the Rock

rule.name: Dutiful Tenacity
rule.rules_text: Each time an attack targets an Adeptus Astartes Infantry or Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit from your army, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

restrictions: Your army can include Dark Angels units, but it cannot include any Adeptus Astartes units drawn from any other Chapter.

enhancements.name: Tempered in Battle (Aura)
enhancements.rules_text: Adeptus Astartes model only. While a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit is within 6 inches of this model, you can re-roll Battle-shock and Leadership tests taken for that unit.

enhancements.name: Ancient Weapons
enhancements.rules_text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Improve the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer by 2, and improve the Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics of those weapons by 1.

enhancements.name: Deathwing Assault
enhancements.rules_text: Deathwing model with the Deep Strike ability only. The bearer's unit can be set up using the Deep Strike ability in the Reinforcements step of your first, second or third Movement phase, regardless of any mission rules.
restrictions: Deathwing model with the Deep Strike ability only.

enhancements.name: Lord of the Ravenwing
enhancements.rules_text: Ravenwing model only. You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit.

stratagems.name: Inescapable Justice
stratagems.timing: Any phase, just after your Oath of Moment target is destroyed.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes Character unit that is on the battlefield.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within 12 inches and visible to your unit. That enemy unit becomes your Oath of Moment target until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: Lion's Will
stratagems.timing: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit. In addition, until the end of the turn, if your unit does not have the Deathwing, Ravenwing or Vehicle keyword, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Tactical Mastery
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced. If your unit has the Ravenwing keyword, it is also eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Relics of the Dark Age
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry or Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Strength characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit.

stratagems.name: Leonine Aggression
stratagems.timing: End of your opponent's Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army within 3 inches of one or more enemy units, or one Deathwing unit from your army within 6 inches of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit now declares a charge that only targets one or more of those enemy units, and you resolve that charge.
restrictions: A unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn if it charges using this Stratagem.

detachments.name: Company of Hunters

rule.name: Masters of Manoeuvre
rule.rules_text: Friendly Adeptus Astartes units have ranged weapons with the [ASSAULT] ability and, when selected to make a Fall Back move, that Fall Back move does not prevent them from being eligible to shoot. Friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted units have ranged attacks with [ASSAULT], can declare a charge after Advancing, and can shoot and declare a charge after Falling Back.

restrictions: Your army can include Dark Angels units, but it cannot include any Adeptus Astartes units drawn from any other Chapter.
keywords: Outrider Squad units from your army gain the Battleline keyword.

enhancements.name: Master-crafted Weapon
enhancements.rules_text: Ravenwing model only. Melee weapons equipped by the bearer have the [PRECISION] ability.

enhancements.name: Mounted Strategist
enhancements.rules_text: Ravenwing model only. You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Master of Manoeuvre
enhancements.rules_text: Ravenwing model only. If the bearer's unit starts the battle in Strategic Reserves, its points value does not count towards the combined points limit for units from your army that are in Strategic Reserve, and for the purposes of setting up that unit on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

enhancements.name: Recon Hunter
enhancements.rules_text: Ravenwing model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Scouts 9 inches ability.

stratagems.name: Hunters' Trail
stratagems.timing: Command phase.
stratagems.target: One Ravenwing Mounted unit from your army that is within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.effect: That objective marker remains under your control even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Talon Strike
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That Adeptus Astartes unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks have [LANCE].

stratagems.name: Death on the Wind
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit ends an Advance move.
stratagems.target: That Adeptus Astartes unit.
stratagems.effect: That Advance move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: High-speed Focus
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Ravenwing unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Rapid Reappraisal
stratagems.timing: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Ravenwing unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

army_rules.name: The Unforgiven
army_rules.rules_text: If an Adeptus Astartes unit has a second Faction keyword on its datasheet, that Faction keyword is the name of that unit's Chapter. For example, Asmodai has both the Adeptus Astartes and Dark Angels Faction keywords, and is therefore from the Dark Angels Chapter. You cannot include units from more than one Chapter in your army.

army_rules.name: The Ravenwing
army_rules.rules_text: The following Adeptus Astartes units gain the Ravenwing keyword if they are drawn from the Dark Angels Chapter: Mounted units; Vehicle units that can Fly.

army_rules.name: The Deathwing
army_rules.rules_text: The following Adeptus Astartes units gain the Deathwing keyword if they are drawn from the Dark Angels Chapter: Terminator units; Bladeguard Ancient, Bladeguard Veteran Squad, Sternguard Veteran Squad and Vanguard Veteran Squad with Jump Packs units; Land Raider, Land Raider Crusader, Land Raider Redeemer, Repulsor and Repulsor Executioner units; Dreadnought units.

chapter_rules.name: Dark Angels Codex Supplement
chapter_rules.rules_text: Dark Angels armies use the Dark Angels supplement rules. The selected Detachment gives access to its enhancements and stratagems. A Dark Angels army cannot include Adeptus Astartes units drawn from more than one Chapter.

abilities.name: Primarch of the First Legion
abilities.rules_text: In your Command phase, select one Primarch of the First Legion abilities. Until the start of your next Command phase, this model has that ability.

abilities.name: The Emperor's Shield
abilities.rules_text: Each time a melee attack is allocated to this model, on an unmodified saving throw of 6, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound after it has finished making its attacks. In addition, each time an attack targets this model, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

abilities.name: Dark Angels Bodyguard
abilities.rules_text: While this model is within 3 inches of one or more friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry units, this model has the Lone Operative ability.

abilities.name: Supreme Commander
abilities.rules_text: If this model is in your army, it must be your Warlord.

selectable_abilities.name: Primarch of the First Legion
selectable_abilities.duration: Until the start of your next Command phase

options.name: All Secrets Revealed
options.rules_text: Once per turn, when your opponent targets a unit from their army with a Stratagem but before that Stratagem's effects are resolved, if that unit is within 12 inches of this model, you gain 1CP and that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. If that test is failed, in addition to that unit being Battle-shocked, that Stratagem's effects are not resolved.

options.name: Martial Exemplar (Aura)
options.rules_text: While a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit is within 6 inches of this model, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

options.name: No Hiding from the Watchers (Aura)
options.rules_text: While a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit is within 6 inches of this model, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.
